blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in La Palma
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: La Palma's own event venues are small-room rentals, so guests arrive from across Orange County and north Los Angeles County and need a single drop point.
The city's private residential streets are not designed for tour-bus parking, so drop-and-go staging is the only workable plan.
Los Cerritos Center and Knott's Berry Farm are only 3-4 miles away on Katella Avenue, making paired day or evening trips natural.
The city sits where the I-5, SR 57 and SR 91 corridors meet, so a chauffeured vehicle handles multi-stop days without navigating traffic.

blocks.text: We also quote La Palma to the hour rather than the trip. blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a La Palma Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
